release.title: First Stable Release & The Oral Sanctuary
changes: Official launch of Echoes of Them on Android & Desktop (Compose Multiplatform).
Sealed Time-Capsule format (.echoes) with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600k iterations) and AES-256-GCM cipher.
Table Mode dual-orientation interface for intimate face-to-face oral storytelling.
Autonomous 40+ year HTML Player export with standard RFC 7845 Ogg Opus audio packages.

beta.title: 10-Language Decks & Waveform Rendering
changes: Preloaded invitation prompt decks across 10 languages (EN, ES, DE, FR, IT, JA, KO, PT, RU, ZH).
Real-time acoustic waveform peak calculation and RMS energy measurement.
Color schemes and colorblind accessibility modes (Deuteranopia, Protanopia, Tritanopia).

alpha.title: C++17 Native Security Shield & Memory Security
changes: Integration of low-level C++17 security library (:security-native) with secure_zero RAM clearing.
Zstandard (Zstd Level 9) compression pipeline for person metadata and timeline indices.
Desktop parity builds for Windows (.msi) and Linux (.deb) verified.
